title: Objectwise qcqs derived projection isomorphism
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Choose derived categories with common localization universe w [def-pc-derived-category]. For E in D_QCoh(O_X) and K in D_QCoh(O_Y), there is an isomorphism Rf_*E\otimes^L K \cong Rf_*(E\otimes^L Lf^*K) using the fixed tensor, pullback and direct image [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. No global quasi-compactness, Noetherianity, coherence, boundedness or support condition on X, Y, E or K is imposed.

source.place: Tag 08EU, Lemma 36.22.1, applied to the fixed derived functors

proof.text: Form the canonical projection map using derived adjunction and the K-flat tensor comparison. Restriction of this canonical map is the canonical map for the restricted morphism. Detect its invertibility on an affine cover of Y.

On Y=Spec A, identify D_QCoh(Y) with D(A). For fixed E the class of K making the map invertible is closed under coproducts because pullback and tensor preserve coproducts and qcqs direct image preserves quasi-coherent coproducts. The tensor input remains quasi-coherent. Exactness and the canonical shift compatibility make this class closed under distinguished triangles.

The map is invertible for every shift of the structure sheaf by the adjunction triangle identity and tensor unit comparison. Generation of D(A) by shifts of A proves invertibility for all K. On an affine cover use the preceding detection and take asIso of the canonical map.

The entire construction uses the supplied localizations; alternatively carry out the K-flat and K-injective computations in standard localizations and transport by Localization.uniq. Their derived universal properties identify pullback and direct image, while K-flat tensor models identify tensor. This gives precisely the displayed objects.

theorem nonempty_qcqs_derivedProjection_iso_universes
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X E)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y K) :
    Nonempty (((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E) ⊗ K ≅
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (E ⊗ (derivedPullback f).obj K))
